message.content:
This is a clean, minimalist "About" page with a soft gradient background and a focus on storytelling. Here's the detailed breakdown:

## Overall Layout & Structure
- **Layout**: Single-column vertical flow with centered content
- **Background**: Soft gradient from pale yellow (#FFF9E0) at top to light mint (#F0F8F0) at bottom
- **Max-width**: Content constrained to ~1200px, centered on page
- **Padding**: 4rem 2rem on all sides (mobile: 2rem 1rem)

## Typography System
- **Primary Font**: Inter (sans-serif) - Google Fonts
- **Secondary Font**: Georgia (serif) - fallback

### Headings
- **H1 "About"**:
  - Font: Inter, 4rem (64px), 700 (bold)
  - Color: #2D3748 (dark slate gray)
  - Letter-spacing: -0.02em
  - Margin-bottom: 2rem

### Subheadings
- **"Our Story"**:
  - Font: Inter, 1.25rem (20px), 500 (medium)
  - Color: #4A5568 (slate gray)
  - Margin-bottom: 3rem

### Body Text
- **Paragraphs**:
  - Font: Inter, 1.125rem (18px), 400 (regular)
  - Color: #2D3748
  - Line-height: 1.75
  - Max-width: 800px
  - Margin-bottom: 2rem

## Visual Elements

### Image Section
- **Image**: Person rock climbing
  - Width: 300px (fixed)
  - Height: 400px (fixed)
  - Border-radius: 8px
  - Box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)
  - Margin-right: 3rem (desktop)
  - Margin-bottom: 2rem (mobile)

### Button
- **"Learn More"**:
  - Background: #2B6CB0 (navy blue)
  - Color: #F6E05E (yellow)
  - Font: Inter, 1rem (16px), 500
  - Padding: 1rem 2rem
  - Border-radius: 50px
  - Border: none
  - Box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)
  - Transition: all 0.3s ease
  - Hover: Background #3182CE, Box-shadow 0 6px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)

## Spacing & Layout Details
- **Section spacing**: 6rem vertical between major sections
- **Text spacing**: 1.5rem between paragraphs
- **Button positioning**: Aligned left with text, margin-top: 2rem

## Color Palette
- Background gradient: #FFF9E0 → #F0F8F0
- Primary text: #2D3748
- Secondary text: #4A5568
- Accent: #2B6CB0 (button)
- Accent text: #F6E05E (button text)

## Responsive Design
- **Mobile breakpoint**: 768px
- **Image**: Full width, margin: 0 0 2rem 0
- **Button**: Full width on mobile
- **Text**: Adjusted line-height for readability

## Design Tokens
- **Primary color**: #2B6CB0
- **Secondary color**: #F6E05E
- **Text color**: #2D3748
- **Background color**: #FFF9E0
- **Border radius**: 8px (image), 50px (button)
- **Shadow**: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)
- **Spacing unit**: 1rem (16px)

The design emphasizes readability with generous line-height and spacing, uses a calming color palette appropriate for outdoor gear, and maintains a clean hierarchy with clear visual separation between sections.
